sources.name: DOH Epidemiology Bureau weekly surveillance (EPI)
sources.purpose: NCR city-week classification, plus archived historical analyses; raw input remains unchanged.

sources.name: City of Manila health department
sources.purpose: Daily case data provided to the project team; formal citation pending data owner

sources.name: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA)
sources.purpose: Existing NCR 2020 denominators; national unit-aligned denominators unverified, so outlook uses count ranks and discloses population confounding
sources.licence: source-specific terms; no blanket government-data licence assumed

sources.name: geoBoundaries / NAMRIA / PSA / OCHA Philippines
sources.purpose: Local Philippines province display geometry; simplified from geoBoundaries ADM2, plus existing NCR city shapes
sources.range: ADM2 represents 2020; existing NCR ADM3 valid 2025-02-13, not historical boundary proof
sources.licence: CC BY 3.0 IGO; retain NAMRIA/PSA/OCHA attribution; simplification changes geometry

sources.name: Open-Meteo / Copernicus C3S / ECMWF ERA5
sources.purpose: Historical centroid weather validation and separately labeled forecast context; weather excluded from outlook unless validated
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 data; free hosted API is for non-commercial use within fair-use limits

sources.name: NASA POWER / NASA Langley Research Center
sources.purpose: Historical weather cross-check for four polygon centroids, 2018–2020. NASA POWER is funded by the NASA Applied Sciences Program within the Earth Science Division of the Science Mission Directorate; web services collaborate with the NASA Langley Research Center Atmospheric Science Data Center (ASDC).
sources.range: See cached provenance; existing Manila historical cross-check
sources.licence: NASA POWER data access/acknowledgement terms; see original receipts

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.purpose: Existing exploratory water/geography context; community data never enters official forecasts
sources.range: Provider snapshot dates in cache receipts

sources.range: SRTM mission elevation / provider cache dates

sources.name: PAGASA
